notes.hook: The opening statement is factual but lacks immediate emotional urgency.
notes.clarity: Narrative sequence is logical and easy to follow.
notes.payoff: Contrast between official inaction and individual heroism is effective.
notes.visuals: Archival photos are highly relevant and well-synchronized.
notes.loop: Visual and verbal repetition provides a smooth transition.

frames.problem: The map text and quarter labels are too small for mobile viewing.
